patch_description:
Replace the random, unoptimized point sample with a deterministic differential-evolution search specialized for the Heilbronn objective. The search fixes three points at the vertices of a reference triangle and optimizes the remaining ten interior points. This guarantees a convex unit reference hull, makes every candidate feasible through reflection into the triangle, and permits direct maximization of the normalized minimum triangle area.

All 286 triangle determinants are evaluated simultaneously for a population of candidates. Selection uses the minimum determinant as the dominant term and a small bonus for the lower tail of triangle areas, which avoids configurations where one triangle is improved at the expense of many nearly-degenerate ones. The fixed seed and fixed iteration schedule make the result reproducible.
